overview: With white sand beaches, thriving nightlife, gilded temples and modern skylines, Thailand offers something for everyone. This incredible capacity to delight everyone from rugged backpackers to the jet-setting swish set is why it’s often called the Land of Smiles. Our Mono Phuket package takes you to the idyllic seaside resort of Phuket with its palm-fringed beaches, quaint flea markets and colonial villas.

days.title: Arrival at Phuket - Transfer to Krabi
days.body: Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, meet our local tour coordinator who will meet and greet you at the specified area and transfer you to your Krabi hotel. Check in to your hotel (Standard Check in time: 1400 - 1500 hours) and relax. Rest of the day is free at your own leisure. In the evening you can go out and get acquainted to your nearby areas and relish some freshly made cuisines at local seaside restaurants. Later return to hotel and sleep relaxed.

days.title: Full Day Krabi Four Island Tour by Long Tail Boat
days.body: After breakfast, proceed for Krabi Four Island Day Trip. Explore the islands of Koh Tup, Koh Gai, Koh Poda and Phra Nang Cave Beach via boat on this day trip from Krabi. Start your day trip in the morning by first going to the scenic Koh Tup Island, famed for its tidal sandbank. Wonder at the unique formation of shoals and picturesque coastline. Next, head over to Koh Gai Island, also known as Chicken Island for its similar appearance to the head of a chicken. Here dive into the exquisite, azure water for a swim or go snorkelling to closely observe the variety of sea creatures. Break for a delicious picnic lunch at Koh Poda Island and take time to relax on the white sandy beach, snooze in the sun, and observe the stunning scenery. Your last stop is at the breathtaking Phra Nang Cave Beach. Explore the grotto caves, watch as daring climbers ascend the rocks, and swim in the warm waters inside the caves.

days.title: Transfer from Krabi to Phuket
days.body: Take your fill at breakfast early this morning, pack your bags and check out from the hotel. Today we bid goodbye to Krabi and further our vacation to a much more exotic destination - Phuket. On arrival at Phuket, check in to your hotel (Standard Check in time: 1400 - 1500 hours) and relax. Rest of the day is free at your own leisure. In the evening you can go out and get acquainted to your nearby areas and relish some freshly made cuisines at local seaside restaurants. Later return to hotel and sleep relaxed

days.title: Phi Phi Island Tour by Speedboat
days.body:
07:30 Begin your day early with convenient hotel pickup in Phuket.
08:30 You will be transferred to the Phuket Boat Lagoon Marina, where you can enjoy light refreshments such as coffee, tea, and snacks before embarking on your adventure.
09:00 Our first destination is Maya Bay, famously known for its appearance in the movie 'The Beach' starring Leonardo DiCaprio. Take a refreshing swim in the crystal clear waters before we move on to other breathtaking sites including Monkey Beach, Pileh Cove, Viking Cave, and Loh Samah Bay.
12:30 Afterwards, we will make a stop at Phi Phi Don Island for a delicious buffet lunch. Following the meal, we will continue our journey by speedboat to a secluded snorkeling spot where you can explore the vibrant marine life and colorful corals.
15:00 Our final destination is Khai Island, a picturesque location offering pristine white sand beaches. Here, you can engage in various water activities such as swimming, snorkeling, or simply sunbathe. For those interested, there is also the option to try out additional water sports like banana boat rides or jet skiing, at your own expense.
17:00 As the day comes to an end, we will return to the Phuket marina in the late afternoon. From there, you will be transferred back to your hotel via minivan, concluding our tour.

days.title: Departure from Phuket
days.body: After breakfast, checkout from your hotel. You will be picked up and transfered to the airport to catch your flight back home. Your trip ends with sweet memories.
